[trp_language language="en_GB"]Get in touch with MedLuxLife — we arrange medical consultations with our partner clinics and carefully planned travel with trusted international partners.[/trp_language][trp_language language="de_DE"]Nehmen Sie Kontakt mit MedLuxLife auf – wir vermitteln medizinische Konsultationen bei unseren Partnerkliniken und organisieren sorgfältig geplante Reisen mit vertrauenswürdigen internationalen Partnern.[/trp_language][trp_language language="tr_TR"]MedLuxLife ile iletişime geçin — partner kliniklerimizde tıbbi görüşmeler ayarlıyor, güvenilir uluslararası partnerlerimizle özenle planlanmış seyahatler organize ediyoruz.[/trp_language]

+49 160 93 44 87 14

+380 97 909 23 26 (WhatsApp)

info@medluxlife.de

[trp_language language="en_GB"]We speak Turkish, Ukrainian, Russian, English and German.[/trp_language][trp_language language="de_DE"]Wir sprechen Türkisch, Ukrainisch, Russisch, Englisch und Deutsch.[/trp_language][trp_language language="tr_TR"]Türkçe, Ukraynaca, Rusça, İngilizce ve Almanca konuşuyoruz.[/trp_language]

[contact-form-7 id="589" title="MedLuxLife Contact" html_class="medlux-form"]

Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to the most common questions about our health and travel services.

Send us your enquiry via the contact form, by email or on WhatsApp. We will get back to you, talk through your wishes and explain the next steps. The first consultation is free of charge and non-binding.

No. MedLuxLife informs, organises and coordinates. Treatments are carried out by qualified doctors at our partner hospital and partner clinics, and the treatment contract is concluded directly with them. Whether a treatment is suitable for you is decided by the treating doctor.

At our partner hospital and partner clinics in Türkiye. We coordinate your appointments, accommodation and transfers so that you can concentrate on your treatment.

Please do not send detailed medical information or documents via the contact form or WhatsApp. If documents are needed, the doctor will ask for them in your online consultation and you share them directly with the doctor.

Every treatment is planned individually, so we do not publish prices on our website. After the consultation you receive a personal written offer.

Yes. Our travel services – holiday packages, hotel reservations, flight tickets, airport transfers and Hajj & Umrah – are independent of our health services and can be booked on their own.

Yes. We arrange Hajj and Umrah trips together with licensed tour operators and inform you about the passport, visa and vaccination requirements.

We are happy to assist you in German, English, Turkish, Ukrainian and Russian.

MedLuxLife is based in Aachen, Germany.

Please send your cancellation to info@medluxlife.de. Details can be found in our cancellation policy and our withdrawal information.

+49 160 93 44 87 14

+380 97 909 23 26 (WhatsApp)

info@medluxlife.de

We speak Turkish, Ukrainian, Russian, English and German.



    Preferred language for our conversation

    Please do not send medical information or documents here. If documents are needed, the doctor will ask for them in your online consultation.

    Translation for information (the German text is binding): I expressly consent, in accordance with Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR, to MedLuxLife processing the health data I provide for the medical pre-assessment, the preparation of an offer and the organisation of my requested treatment. I have read the Consent Declaration on Health Data.

    Translation for information (the German text is binding): I expressly consent, in accordance with Art. 49(1)(a) GDPR, to the personal data required for my enquiry, including health data, being transferred to the medical provider in Türkiye selected for my enquiry. I have been informed that there is no adequacy decision of the EU Commission for Türkiye and that the transfer may therefore involve particular data protection risks.

    Beide Einwilligungen sind freiwillig und können jederzeit mit Wirkung für die Zukunft widerrufen werden.

    Translation for information: Both consents are voluntary and can be withdrawn at any time with effect for the future.
